about: Amherst is a town in northern Nova Scotia at the edge of the Tantramar Marshes, the highway and rail gateway toward New Brunswick—not Amherstburg, Ontario. A brick downtown, sandstone civic buildings, and marshland dykes define this Cumberland County service centre. About 9,000 people live in Amherst.
